title: How Much Audio Is Left In An Embedding? An Inversion Audit Of Audio Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.12250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained audio encoders are reused for downstream tasks that are often unknown when the encoder is trained, so their usefulness depends partly on which signal properties survive the pretext objective. We study this retained information through paired source reconstruction. Using a shared Stable Audio Open latent diffusion decoder, we reconstruct five-second, 44.1-kHz stereo music from frozen representations produced by supervised classifiers (VGGish, ConvNeXt), an audio-text contrastive model (CLAP), and a waveform-reconstruction model (EnCodec). These objectives impose different pressures to preserve source detail, while their exposed interfaces vary substantially in temporal and spectral resolution. Evaluating on the Million Song Dataset (MSD), we find clear differences in reconstructability across encoder families, while within encoder comparisons show improved recovery when finer temporal or spectral structure is exposed. translated_title: 嵌入中还剩下多少音频？对音频编码器的反演审计
translated_abstract: 预训练的音频编码器常被复用于在编码器训练时尚未确定的下游任务，因此其有用性部分取决于哪些信号特性在预训练目标（pretext objective）中得以保留。我们通过配对的源音频重建来研究这些被保留的信息。利用共享的 Stable Audio Open 潜在扩散解码器，我们从监督分类器（VGGish、ConvNeXt）、音频-文本对比模型（CLAP）以及波形重建模型（EnCodec）产生的冻结表示中重建五秒钟、44.1 kHz 的立体声音乐。这些训练目标对源细节的保留施加了不同的压力，而它们所暴露的接口在时间和频谱分辨率上差异显著。在 Million Song Dataset（MSD）上的评估表明，不同编码器家族之间的可重建性存在明显差异；而在编码器内部的比较显示，当暴露更精细的时间或频谱结构时，恢复效果更好。即使……
tldr: 本文提出一种“反演审计”方法，利用共享的 Stable Audio Open 潜在扩散解码器从 VGGish、ConvNeXt、CLAP、EnCodec 等音频编码器的冻结嵌入中重建源音乐，发现不同预训练目标的编码器残留的音频信息量差异显著，且接口暴露的时间/频谱分辨率越细，重建恢复效果越好。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an "inversion audit" that uses a shared Stable Audio Open latent diffusion decoder to reconstruct source music from frozen embeddings of audio encoders (VGGish, ConvNeXt, CLAP, EnCodec), revealing significant differences in retained audio information across pretext objectives and better recovery when finer temporal or spectral structure is exposed.
